## Permanent batch rule
This Issue is one fixed batch in the CLOSED-ISSUE FORENSIC PROGRAM. The batch membership is frozen below. When the user asks to complete this Issue number, process ONLY its listed closed issues unless an explicit carry-over instruction says otherwise.

For EVERY issue in this batch:
- Closed/Open state is not engineering evidence.
- Read issue body AND comments AND linked commits/evidence.
- Independently reconstruct the historical claim.
- Establish APK/package identity where applicable.
- Distinguish historical runtime commit from current HEAD.
- Require runtime trace + ViewTree/provenance + state-change evidence where relevant.
- Require screenshot metrics/SHA and 3-run proof for high-value visual/game claims.
- Apply pixel-truth: white/2-color/near-blank/placeholder/grey/custom-view is NOT a golden.
- Games require actual visible content and interaction/state-change evidence for gameplay claims.
- No package-specific hacks.
- Classify false closures, historical-only verification, current regression, blocked APK/fetch, partial closure, test-only, superseded, or verified current.
- Record exact evidence references and gaps.
- Update the SAME Issue with a completion ledger: STATUS — RESULT — EVIDENCE.
- Commit canonical batch artifacts.
- Do not declare completion because files exist; evidence-backed per-issue classification is mandatory.

Required per-issue fields:
issue_number, title, historical_claim, historical_evidence, tested_runtime_commit, current_head, apk_identity, runtime_proof, viewtree_proof, state_change_proof, screenshot_metrics, reproducibility, first_divergence, root_family, pixel_truth, final_classification, evidence_refs, notes.


### Required artifacts
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_AUDIT.md
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_AUDIT.jsonl
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_CLAIMS_VS_EVIDENCE.md
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_FALSE_CLOSURES.md
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_REGRESSION_STATUS.jsonl
- docs/CLOSED_BATCH_1_EVIDENCE_INDEX.jsonl

### Completion gate
All 50 issues classified individually. High-value visual/game claims rerun where feasible, with 3-run proof. Completion ledger posted back to this Issue.
